note: Attacker-controlled input is handed to the JSON packer for tokenization and conversion.
The raw bytes are tokenized as JSON; malformed or edge-case structures drive parser state.
The converter walks JSMN tokens and trusts token boundaries and parent links to describe the JSON tree.
Primitive tokens are interpreted directly from the original buffer using token offsets.
Numeric primitives are converted with libc parsing functions that assume a valid NUL-terminated numeric string.

note: The produced MsgPack is unpacked again and later iterated as a map, so any malformed conversion can corrupt downstream assumptions.
The parser re-emits map entries by indexing token-derived map slots; a bad map layout here can reach the memory-safety sink.
